name: Selfish People
overview: Scripture reveals that selfishness is a heart condition marked by greed, pride, and a lack of love for others. The Lord commands us to love our neighbors as ourselves, rejecting grudges and vengeful attitudes (Leviticus 19:18). Selfish people are described as greedy and insatiable, pursuing their own gain without understanding or regard for others (Isaiah 56:11). This self-centeredness leads to separation from wisdom and a false confidence in one’s own purity despite inner corruption (Proverbs 18:1; 30:12). The unrighteousness of selfishness ultimately provokes God's indignation and wrath (Romans 2:8), underscoring the necessity of a heart inclined away from covetousness toward obedience to God’s truth (Psalms 119:36).
